column2: The start of the trek up the mountain is calm enough with rolling, generally grassy hills
A heard of goats, with a goatherd watching them
At any edge of civilization ogres can be found attacking those that venture beyond it. The mountains are no exception
column3: An ogre defends the path and must be fought to continue

column2: A pile of boulders has crashed down from a nearby peak, blocking the pathway
The path stops abruptly in a rock face
There is a rickety ladder that goes up this section of rock
As soon as you put weight on the ladder it falls apart, the wood too old to be used
this is as far up the mountain as the path goes, beyond here so few adventurers make it
column3: Rockwall Redbeard can show you the way from here to the valley of shrines

column2: Finally a safe place, you can rest here for  the night before continuing
As you climb higher icy winds blow down from the mountain top
A group of 6 zombies, different from normal their skin is tight and white, almost mummified
This cave is not so safe, but there is magic here
You must cross a sheet of ice to continue towards the valley
The corpses of a pair of adventurers who previouly attempted this journey for the king
As you examine the two corpses they groan, stand up, and attack you with hunger and despair in their eyes
A Golem stands guard at the entrance to the valley of shrines
